decisions.reason: As a publicly presented 2019 launch that fits the firm's airport-focused innovation push, the app is likely to be retained because management can justify weak traction as temporary, though its narrower scope makes it somewhat easier to cut than the larger systems.

This passenger processing technology line appears to embody the firm's announced move toward high-end integrated security technology, so its larger apparent investment and visibility make management likely to continue it rather than admit failure.

The self-service check-in solution is close to the firm's core customer base and innovation narrative, so despite uncertainty about results, management would likely persist because of sunk development effort and strategic fit.
